eyebrow.zh: 开源 · 单文件 · 纯本地
eyebrow.en: Open source · single binary · fully local

headline.zh:
把对话记录
搬进下一个 Agent
headline.en:
Move your history
into your next Agent

sub.zh: ChatPort 读入 ChatGPT 官方导出 zip，归一化为统一的 Context Pack 中间表示并输出统计——单文件二进制、全程本地、零模型调用。上下文包渲染随 v0.2 落地；本站只展示已实现的能力。
sub.en: ChatPort reads the official ChatGPT export zip, normalizes it into one Context Pack intermediate representation, and prints statistics — a single binary, fully local, zero model calls. Pack rendering lands in v0.2; this site only shows what is already implemented.

body.zh: 不需要插件或抓取：你从 ChatGPT 设置页导出的 zip，chatport parse 直接读入，立刻给出对话数、消息数、时间跨度与项目分组统计。
body.en: No plugins, no scraping: hand chatport parse the zip you exported from ChatGPT's settings page, and it immediately reports conversations, messages, time span and project grouping.

body.zh: 所有解析器写进同一个 App 无关的中间表示：meta / threads / digest（去重指纹、项目分组、单文件大小预算）。--json 输出的就是 v0.2 渲染器要消费的数据。
body.en: Every parser writes into the same app-agnostic intermediate representation — meta / threads / digest with dedup fingerprints, project groups and a per-file size budget. --json emits exactly what the v0.2 renderer will consume.

title.zh: 确定性规则，零模型调用

body.zh: 去重只认空白归一后逐字相同的消息（sha256 指纹），分组只认标题前缀——可解释、可复现。全程本机运行：无账号、无遥测、无上传。
body.en: Dedup matches only messages identical after whitespace normalization (sha256 fingerprints); grouping reads title prefixes only — explainable and reproducible. Everything runs on your machine: no account, no telemetry, no uploads.

note.zh: 以下命令与输出逐字来自 docs/demo-results.json——2026-10-10 在 go1.24.1 (darwin/arm64) 上对 v0.1.0 的验证记录。样例导出是合成的（非真实用户数据）；你自己的导出 zip 输出同样的统计。
note.en: The commands and outputs below are verbatim from docs/demo-results.json — the verified run of v0.1.0 on go1.24.1 (darwin/arm64), 2026-10-10. The sample export is synthetic (not real user data); your own export zip produces the same statistics.

body.zh: 单文件二进制，make build 即得
body.en: A single-file binary, straight from make build

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。从源码构建（仓库自带一份合成样例导出）：
body.en: Go 1.24+ required. Build from source (the repo ships a synthetic sample export):

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/chatport
cd chatport
make build

limitations.zh: v0.1 只解析 ChatGPT 数据导出（conversations.json）；国产 App 适配尚未接入（v0.3，以 Gate-0 审计为前提）。
limitations.en: v0.1 only parses ChatGPT data exports (conversations.json); no CN app adapter is wired yet (v0.3, behind the Gate-0 audit).

limitations.zh: 上下文包渲染（claude-projects-pack.zip）在本里程碑未实现；--json 暴露的 Context Pack IR 是 v0.2 渲染器的输入。
limitations.en: Rendering (claude-projects-pack.zip) is not implemented in this milestone; the Context Pack IR exposed by --json is what the v0.2 renderer will consume.

limitations.zh: 去重是空白归一后的确定性精确匹配（sha256 指纹），没有语义去重；项目分组只认标题前缀（【…】、[…]、Project:、项目：）。
limitations.en: Dedup is deterministic exact-match after whitespace normalization (sha256 fingerprints), no semantic dedup; project grouping reads title prefixes only (【…】, […], Project:, 项目：).

limitations.zh: ChatGPT 导出不含 memory 与自定义指令，包里因此也没有；被编辑掉的回复分支（非 current_node 路径）不保留。
limitations.en: ChatGPT exports do not include memory or custom instructions, so the pack does not either; edited-away reply branches (anything off the current_node path) are not kept.

limitations.zh: v0.1 的网页预览是占位页：chatport open 只提供版本信息与使用指引。
limitations.en: The v0.1 web preview is a placeholder: chatport open serves version info and usage guidance only.

caption.zh: 示意场景：导出的对话汇入 Context Pack，再流向下一个 Agent
caption.en: Illustrative scene: exports converge into a Context Pack, then flow to the next Agent

body.zh: 多助手重度用户的真实工作流：在 ChatGPT 里磨一个项目，拿去 Claude 写方案，再开一个 Coding Agent 把它做出来。每次切换都要复制背景、重新解释决策——因为官方导出是给监管看的数据所有权文件，不是给下一个助手吃的格式，而没有任何助手提供“吃进别人历史”的入口。
body.en: The real workflow of multi-assistant power users: grind a project in ChatGPT, take it to Claude to write it up, then open a Coding Agent to build it. Every switch means copying background and explaining decisions again — because official exports are regulatory data-ownership artifacts, not interoperability formats, and no assistant ships an ingest primitive for another service's history.

body.zh: 导出（设置页一次点击）→ 解析（parse 一条命令）→ 统计（对话数、消息数、时间跨度、项目分组）→ 上下文包（v0.2：按项目分组、去重、按大小预算分片的 Markdown）。前三步已上线，每步的用户操作都在一分钟内。
body.en: Export (one click in settings) → parse (one command) → stats (conversations, messages, time span, project groups) → context pack (v0.2: project-grouped, deduplicated, size-budgeted Markdown). The first three steps ship today; every user step stays under a minute.

alt.zh: ChatPort 核心流程：导出、解析与统计已实现，上下文包渲染在 v0.2
alt.en: ChatPort core process: export, parse and stats are implemented; pack rendering arrives in v0.2

body.zh: ingest 把导出归一化进 Context Pack IR，render 与 web 从同一个 IR 读出。第三方依赖仅 cobra，zip、HTTP、静态资源全部走标准库——无数据库、无服务端依赖、不联网。
body.en: ingest normalizes exports into the Context Pack IR; render and web read from the same IR. The only third-party dependency is cobra — zip, HTTP and static assets come from the standard library. No database, no server, no network.

alt.zh: 架构图：ingest 写入 Context Pack IR，render 与 web 在后续版本读取
alt.en: Architecture: ingest writes the Context Pack IR; render and web read it in later milestones

title.en: Where it sits: the convert stage

body.zh: 导出归各助手的官方导出负责，上传归目标 App 已有的项目知识入口负责，ChatPort 只做中间缺失的转换：去重、按项目分组、按预算分片。v0.1 接 ChatGPT 一对，国产适配按 Gate-0 审计结果逐对解锁。
body.en: Official exports handle taking data out; the target app's existing project-knowledge entry handles taking it in. ChatPort owns the missing middle: dedup, project grouping, budget sharding. v0.1 wires one pair (ChatGPT); domestic adapters unlock pair-by-pair behind a Gate-0 audit.

alt.zh: 能力与接入图：ChatGPT 导出与终端统计已接通，Claude Projects 渲染与国产适配在路线图上
alt.en: Capability map: ChatGPT exports and terminal statistics are wired; Claude Projects rendering and CN adapters are on the roadmap

body.zh: v0.1 的完整 CLI：parse 读入导出并输出统计（--stats 每对话明细，--json 完整 IR），open 启动 localhost 预览页。
body.en: The complete v0.1 CLI: parse reads an export and prints statistics (--stats per-conversation detail, --json the full IR); open starts the localhost preview page.

details.code:
chatport parse export.zip            # 概要统计
chatport parse export.zip --stats    # 每对话明细
chatport parse export.zip --json     # 完整 Context Pack IR
chatport open                        # localhost 预览页（v0.1 占位）

body.zh: v0.1 的转换是确定性规则、零模型调用——可解释、可复现，也意味着不聪明；规则会随 v0.2 的渲染需求演进。
body.en: v0.1 conversion is deterministic rules with zero model calls — explainable and reproducible, which also means not clever; the rules evolve with v0.2's rendering needs.

sub.zh: v0.1 内测期，解析与统计免费使用。欢迎在 Issues 里反馈搬家前后的真实体验。
sub.en: v0.1 is in beta — parsing and statistics are free to use. Real move reports in the Issues tracker are very welcome.

tag.zh: ChatPort 把官方对话导出，变成下一个 Agent 一口吃下的上下文包。
tag.en: ChatPort turns official AI chat exports into a Context Pack your next Agent can ingest.
